name: Langry RH225-A Mechanical Concrete Test Hammer
short_description: The industry-standard mechanical rebound hammer for non-destructive compressive strength estimation of normal structural concrete from 10 to 60 MPa.
description: The **Langry RH225-A Mechanical Concrete Test Hammer** (Type N) is a rugged, precision engineering instrument engineered for non-destructive assessment of in-situ compressive strength in hardened concrete, precast members, pavements, and massive civil infrastructure. Built with an ultra-hard aluminum alloy casing and calibrated internal precision springs, it delivers repeatable rebound measurement according to IS 13311 (Part 2), ASTM C805, and EN 12504-2.

key_features.feature: Standard Type N nominal impact energy of 2.207 Joules (0.225 kgf·m)
Wide testing measuring range covering 10 to 60 MPa compressive strength
Aerospace-grade hardened aluminum housing resistant to harsh jobsite conditions
Precision pointer slider with uniform 0.65 ± 0.15 N friction index
Calibrated against certified steel test anvil yielding 80 ± 2 rebound index
